Header: Erionota spp Sihala: Kesel pathra rol karana dalmbuwa; Tamil: Vaalai ilai suruddi

Prevention: Encourage natural enemies such as insectivorous birds, wasps
Do not transport infected banana plant or leaves
Monitoring: Observe for pink colour egg clusters underneath the young leaves – the first sign
Observe for leaf margin damage by young caterpillars (light green covered with white powder).
Observe for cuts & rolls in mature leaves
Observe for flying, nectar feeding, mating & egg laying skippers closer to banana plantations
Observe yellow pupae covered with white powder within leaf roll
Direct Control: Heating skipper egg clusters and leaf rolls with young caterpillars using fire mounted on a stick
Physical destruction / crushing of leaf rolls with the pest (caterpillars as well as pupae)
Destroy the skipper using a light trap – if the population is very high
Restrictions: Banana leaves are used as food wraps.
A lot of beneficial arthropods are present underneath the leaves
No need to apply insecticides – easy to manage with non- chemical methods
